card.name: Digits inside numbers in dose tables
card.fires_on: The digit 0 or a decimal point in the middle of a multi-digit number, such as 10, 20, 0.19 or 10.8. It appears mostly in dose tables, strengths and percentages.

modes.label: Zero within a number
modes.description: The digit 0 after another digit in a dose or strength, such as 20 mg or 100 mg.

modes.label: Decimal point in a value
modes.description: The point between digits in a decimal in a table or in trial percentages.

card.plain: It fires on the middle of a number, like the zero in 20 or the point in 10.8, in dose tables and trial results.
